2012 values transcribed from the comprehensive 2012 comparator in the 2015 official report, table 10. The source uses five mutually exclusive institution categories. Multiple-stage learners are kept separately, not redistributed into the four main stages; school is therefore the reported primary+secondary subtotal, excluding multiple-stage learners.
